filed_edges: [AKIEN] SCOPE ORDER, NOT SHAPE. The ruling is all 9 in one blow. But two other open items — sorted-renders-the-cursor and the-slate-door-has-a-side-path — are edits to skills inside that same roster, so doing the migration first means touching those two skills twice. Either they land first and the migration sweeps a settled roster, or the migration goes first and absorbs them. Cheap to decide, expensive to get backwards.

[CORPUS] WHAT IS THE PROOF THAT THE MIGRATION IS COMPLETE? 'This skill fires and leaves a trace' is checkable per skill. 'All 9 are migrated' has no tooth unless the roster is COMPILED from what is on disk rather than listed by hand — a hand-listed roster of 9 is a tenth artifact to maintain, and the one most likely to go stale the moment a skill is added.

BLOCKED 2026-08-05 — THE ANATOMY THIS MIGRATES TO IS WRONG. This ticket moves all nine skills to 'the settled anatomy ... a stratum-tagged bullet-list finding at exit'. Akien, 2026-08-05: 'you've conflated inspectors and learning blocks' — FINDING is the INSPECTOR SUBCLASS's output, not an organ of a learning block, and VERDICT/DIAL are the human gate on an inspector and belong to neither. A learning block is a QUESTION NEXUS: input, feedback from probes, new candidate constraining questions, a domain knowledge base, constraining questions, two loops, output. See notes/2026-08-05-a-learning-block-is-a-question-nexus-an-inspector-is-a-subclass.json. MIGRATING NOW WOULD BUILD THE CHIMERA NINE TIMES. This is the second hold on this ticket tonight and it is the same failure both times: do not migrate onto a model just found wrong.

[AKIEN] WHO EMITS THE FINDING — THE SKILL, OR AN INSPECTOR FOR THAT STEP? This is the hole the 2026-08-05 correction opens, and the migration's shape hangs on it. Findings belong to inspectors, and a skill is a learning block, so either (i) each skill IS an inspector over its own step and emits its own finding, or (ii) each step gets a SEPARATE inspector block that watches it and produces the finding Akien gates. His 2026-08-01 verbatim reads toward (ii) — 'a bullet list finding from an inspector FOR THAT STEP that learns what I will gate' — but that is CC's reading of a line spoken before the subclass distinction existed, not a ruling, and it is recorded here as a reading on purpose. The two answers differ in cost and in what gets built: (i) is nine skills each growing an output slot; (ii) is one inspector class instantiated nine times over specs, which is the shape the engine already has. Until this rules, the migration can safely do the DOOR and TRACE half only.
